intentional_modifications.category: LF09 Causal Source Fix: Multi-Page Deduplication and Cyclic Cursor Early-Exit
intentional_modifications.justification: Added per-item ContainerId deduplication and zero-item progress detection in LoadContainersAsync, ensuring multi-page pagination traverses pages without accumulating duplicates or spinning on cyclic cursors.

intentional_modifications.category: LF09 Causal Source Fix: Multi-Page Coil Deduplication and Cyclic Cursor Early-Exit
intentional_modifications.justification: Added per-item ContainerId deduplication and zero-item progress detection in LoadCoilsAsync, ensuring continuous coil pagination traverses multi-page results safely without duplicate accumulation.

intentional_modifications.category: LF09 Dedicated Named Behavioral Proof Tests (Desktop)
intentional_modifications.justification: Added 5 dedicated named tests proving: (1) discovery and auto-selection of the 51st pack across page boundary, (2) discovery and auto-selection of the 51st coil across page boundary, (3) cyclic page early termination, (4) fail-closed null selection when all pages exhausted with zero eligible packs, and (5) fail-closed remote HTTP error handling.

intentional_modifications.category: LF09 Dedicated Named Behavioral Proof Tests (Server Controller)
intentional_modifications.justification: Added LF09_PackContainersController_TraversalAcrossPages_Discovers51stPack proving server controller ordering puts 50 open packs with 1m remaining on page 1, and the 51st pack with 10m remaining on page 2, and that targeted query with minContinuousLength discovers the 51st pack on page 1.
